title: 第1章 重生回归第2章 感叹的彩儿
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: {脑子保存处，全程高速，请各位帅哥美女扣好安全带}
诸天万界
三千大世界
帝域
一座座屹立于十万里天空的浮岛上，树立着无数宫殿，其中一座位列浮岛最中央的一座宫殿名为神殿
神殿内
一名十岁的孩童盘坐在由灵玉铸成的玉床上，缓缓的睁开眼看着眼前熟悉的景象，右手缓缓的伸向前方的镜子，看着镜子中的自己，一个娇嫩而又清纯的脸蛋和青色的瞳孔出现在眼前，凌浩手抖的摸着自己的脸道
“我这是重生了吗？还是重生回到了十岁的时候”
于是快速的来到门口打开大门看着眼前的一切景象，生怕自己是在做梦，凌浩看着眼前的一切是如此的生动与真实，眼眶里慢慢出现的泪水，下边的奴仆看到凌浩恭敬的道
“见过神子，神子万安”
凌浩听到奴仆的交换便控制住了泪水，轻声道
“嗯，你们各自去藏宝阁拿一枚圣灵丹吧，今日本神子心情好”
顿时下边所有的奴仆顿时高兴的飞向藏宝阁领取圣灵丹
一枚圣灵丹足以让下界顶级强者争破头脑，甚至生死道消都在所不惜，现在凌浩轻声一句就得到一枚圣灵丹，一枚圣灵丹能让一名下界合体期晋升到渡劫期一个境界，且无副作用
三千大世界的境界划分为：仙人境，地仙境，天仙境，玄仙境，金仙境，大罗金仙境，准仙圣境，仙圣境，准仙帝，仙帝，每个境界分初，中，后，巅峰四期
下界为：炼气期，筑基期，结丹期，金丹期，炼婴期，元婴期，婴变期，化神期，合体期，渡劫期，而后就是渡劫飞升三千大世界为红尘仙，再后就是仙人境
神殿内
凌浩盘坐在灵玉床上闭目养神，内视体内精神世界，一颗黑色的石头盘旋在凌浩精神世界里，凌浩看着黑色石头道
“想不到是它让我重生到了十岁，真是造化弄人啊哈哈哈”
这是凌浩前世入九十九层死地得到的石头，当时入准仙帝的凌浩一击之下都未能毁掉的石头竟然有如此造化
“看来有机会，我一定再入九十九层死地一次，一定要弄明白这颗石头到底是什么来历”
凌浩从精神世界出来后，检查自己的当前境界
化神期
十岁的化神期已经不是天才能比喻的了，妖孽甚至都不足以称上，只能用万古天神的天赋才能说明凌浩的天赋吧
凌浩看着自己的境界眼里闪过一丝血光道
“叶辰，没想到吧，我回来了，我不会再像上一世那样给你发育的机会了，我会将你彻底扼杀在摇篮里”
“神子，家主有事叫您过去”
content_en:
{Brain storage place, the whole journey is at high speed, all handsome guys and beauties, please fasten your seat belts}
All heavens and worlds
Three Thousand Worlds
Imperial Domain
There are countless palaces on the floating islands that stand hundreds of thousands of miles into the sky. One of them is the palace in the center of the floating island called the Temple.
inside the temple
A ten-year-old child sat cross-legged on a jade bed made of spiritual jade. He slowly opened his eyes and looked at the familiar scene in front of him. He slowly stretched his right hand towards the mirror in front of him and looked at himself in the mirror. A delicate and pure face and blue pupils appeared in front of him. Ling Hao touched his face with trembling hands and said
"Am I reborn? Or am I reborn back to when I was ten years old?"
So he quickly came to the door and opened it and looked at everything in front of him, fearing that he was dreaming. Ling Hao saw that everything in front of him was so vivid and real, and tears slowly appeared in his eyes. The slave below saw Ling Hao respectfully said
"I have seen the Son of God, and the Son of God is safe and sound."
When Ling Hao heard the exchange of slaves, he controlled his tears and said softly
"Well, each of you can go to the Treasure Pavilion to get a Holy Spirit Pill. The Japanese God is in a good mood today."
Immediately, all the slaves below happily flew to the treasure pavilion to receive the Holy Spirit Pill.
A Holy Spirit Pill is enough to make the top powerhouses in the lower world fight for their wits, and even risk life and death. Now Ling Hao can get a Holy Spirit Pill with just a word. A Holy Spirit Pill can promote a person in the lower realm's integration stage to the level of the Tribulation Stage without any side effects.
The realms of the Three Thousand Great Worlds are divided into: Immortal Realm, Earth Immortal Realm, Heavenly Immortal Realm, Mysterious Immortal Realm, Golden Immortal Realm, Daluo Golden Immortal Realm, Quasi-Immortal Saint Realm, Immortal Saint Realm, Quasi-Immortal Emperor, Immortal Emperor. Each realm is divided into four stages: Beginner, Middle, Late and Peak.
The lower realms are: Qi refining stage, foundation building stage, elixir formation stage, golden elixir stage, infant refining stage, Yuan Ying stage, infant transformation stage, spirit transformation stage, integration stage, transcending tribulation period, and then to transcend tribulations and ascend to three thousand worlds to become a mortal immortal, and then to the immortal realm.
inside the temple
Ling Hao sat cross-legged on the spiritual jade bed, closed his eyes and meditated, looking inside at the spiritual world inside his body. A black stone hovered in Ling Hao's spiritual world. Ling Hao looked at the black stone and said
"I didn't expect it to make me reborn at the age of ten. What a trick of fate, hahaha."
This is the stone that Ling Hao obtained after entering the ninety-ninth level of death in his previous life. At that time, Ling Hao, who had entered the Quasi-Immortal Emperor, could not destroy the stone with a single blow. How could it be so good?
"It seems that if I have a chance, I will definitely go to the ninety-ninth level of death again, and I will definitely understand the origin of this stone."
After Ling Hao came out of the spiritual world, he checked his current state
Transformation stage
The ten-year-old stage of transformation into a god is no longer something that can only be compared to a genius. It is not even enough to be called a monster. Ling Hao's talent can only be explained by the talent of an eternal god.
Ling Hao looked at his own realm and a flash of blood flashed in his eyes.
"Ye Chen, you didn't expect it. I'm back. I won't give you the chance to grow like I did in my last life. I will completely strangle you in the cradle."
"Son of God, the master of the house has called you over if he has something to do."
